title: Settings
subtitle: Configure the building blocks your team uses to report and categorise work.

sla.title: SLA targets
sla.hint: Resolution time per priority. New work orders get a due date from this automatically.

assign.title: Auto-assignment
assign.hint: When a work order is created, the first matching rule sets the assignee.

automation.title: Automation
automation.publicHint: Let anyone with the QR code or link report a fault without signing in.
automation.autoHint: Turn every new fault report into a work order automatically — then auto-assignment and SLA targets apply.

general.title: Organisation profile
general.hint: Basic details used across the workspace.
general.name: Name
general.aiSentiment: Score inbox messages' sentiment with AI
general.aiSentimentHint: Off by default. When on, the text of incoming customer messages is sent to Anthropic (Claude) to detect unhappy customers for the "low sentiment" workflow trigger. Mention this in your privacy notice.
general.adminOnly: Only an organisation admin can edit these.

catalogs.hint: Manage the fault and asset types your team can choose from.
catalogs.defaultsLoaded: Default types loaded (only added when a catalog was empty).

catalogs.faultInUse_other: "{{name}}" is used by {{count}} requests — deactivate it instead of deleting.
catalogs.assetInUse_one: "{{name}}" is used by {{count}} asset — deactivate it instead of deleting.
catalogs.assetInUse_other: "{{name}}" is used by {{count}} assets — deactivate it instead of deleting.

siteAccess.unrestricted: Unrestricted — this member sees every site. Check a site below to confine them to it.
siteAccess.confined: Confined to the checked site(s) only.

profile.saveFirst: Save the profile once to start adding certifications.

integrations.iotHint: Manage device keys and ingest endpoints from the Devices page.
integrations.whatsappNone: No WhatsApp number is connected. Contact FacilitySpace support to connect your business number; replies to WhatsApp conversations can't be delivered until then.
integrations.deliveryHint: Outbound messages are delivered by the process-outbox function (Resend / Twilio / web-push). Set the provider secrets and schedule the function to enable delivery.
integrations.emailMeHint: When on, in-app notifications addressed to you are also emailed.
